issue: PMAT-224 (forjar#491) — the committed-quorum gate had no shape a kind:triage branch could satisfy: no Rust test to name, no citable path, its own receipt outside its rail, so every triage PR was pushed waived. A receipt may now declare kind: triage; the gate verifies the rail from the diff, requires the falsification block to say not_applicable and prints what it did not verify, and documentation the branch touches anchors its claims for that kind only.

quorum.kill_rule: the plan was grilled before a line was written and the finished diff was judged by three lanes with the base pinned; a lane could fail the whole diff on one refuted claim, and every lane claim was re-run by the orchestrator before it counted
quorum.rounds: one sandboxed teamwork lane on the plan (single model; two plan claims refuted and corrected before the fix was written), then three sandboxed --mode plan lanes on the diff at 15418d23 (3/3 PASS, lane-reduce agreed, one honest refutation of a claim's wording), then the orchestrator's reruns, the hook's own refusal and the workspace gate
refuted_claims: Widen the citation shape to documentation for every receipt; the must-be-touched rule closes the free-rider path. Corrected: a code branch always touches the receipt and ledger it writes, so documentation anchors only when the receipt declares kind: triage, and the gate's rail refusal makes declaring the kind useless for a code diff.

The triage arm bypasses only test_file and cargo_test_target. Corrected: the block's first loop already requires test, reverted and observed_failure, so the whole block is replaced by the not_applicable shape for kind: triage, and the gate prints it.

The extraction of seven helpers is strictly behaviour-preserving. Corrected: the seven extractions are; receipt_identity also carries the new guard refusing a kind other than code or triage — a message main could not print on a field it did not read; a receipt with no kind takes the identical path.

crux.verdict: accept(Gerrit: per-change-type submit rules with the missing label displayed; monorepo presubmits: a docs-only change reports no affected targets, never all tests passed; Debian: a declared absence is printed, an undeclared one rejected; bors: a reduced job set is named in the merge) and reject(the waiver: a free-text reason accepted in place of a shape, which teaches every author whose change does not fit that the reason field is the gate)
